findings.title: Remote recovery-code updates leave old local codes valid
findings.body: If a user already has a local recovery-code credential and their user storage accepts this update, this writes the new codes to user storage without removing the local credential. The old local codes can therefore remain valid after the user has regenerated or revoked them. Remove the local credential on successful remote replacement, or otherwise ensure validation treats the remote credential as authoritative.

findings.title: The user-storage fixture accepts recovery codes repeatedly
findings.body: This validator only checks whether the submitted code appears in the stored list and never marks it used or removes it. As a result, the same recovery code can authenticate repeatedly in the new user-storage path, and the added test—which uses each code only once—does not detect this violation of recovery-code one-time-use semantics. Make the fixture consume a code on successful validation and test that replay is rejected.
